title: HLSE Network Verdict
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json network` — detects suspicious network activity such as C2 beaconing and data exfiltration.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict.

reasons.description: Suspicious activity indicators. Empty for SAFE verdicts.

signal_count.description: Number of independent C2/exfiltration indicators (score > 0 only).

pattern_id.description: Stable SIEM/SOAR routing token (present iff pattern is present).

objective.description: The attacker's likely objective (score >= 40 — ALERT band and above).

verify.description: Independent check before isolating (score >= 40 — ALERT band and above).

triage.description: Immediate isolation and evidence preservation (score >= 60 only).

cascade_risk.description: Credentials and sessions at risk (score >= 60 only).
